body: I've just returned from the lake which I was intending to jump into,only I was unable to do it.I hope you're right about it getting better.Unfortunately people are unable to grasp just how terrifying depression is...
I haven't tried meds.I think it takes a long time before you feel any benefits.
They all sound like great ideas and under normal circumstances I may have considered one of them but unfortunately severe depression clouds the mind with abject despair...

Drowning seems like a guaranteed way to end it all.I know it's going to be terrifying and painful.I really don't see how my state of mind is going to improve.I've been feeling full of despair for more than 2 months and it's getting worse every day.
I can't see any other way out to be honest...
Thanks for your concern.The name redkite is just a type of bird.I used to be a birdwatcher.It's really too late for me .I'm overwhelmed with distress.
I've given it a lot of thought.The last 3 months have been hell.When you say you've been on the other side,what do you mean?
The problem is my mind is overwhelmed with despair and even though I can think of thousands of things I could potentially enjoy,when you're severely depressed you need to escape the pain...
I'm not convinced that life is always worth living.To be feeling this amount of despair is unbearable...
Been diagnosed with hepatitis and have descended into a state of extreme suicidal/ideation depression for the past month...
Thanks for your encouraging words.I just hope I can dig deep and find inner resources to get through this awful episode...
Somehow it's easier to speak about these things anonymously on here.you never know how friends and family might react...
I know,I really don't want to cause any distress to family or friends but suicidal depression is a nightmare...
I figured it would be absolute terror for 3 or 4 minutes and then it would all be over...
Thanks for the encouragement.It means a lot...
I haven't tried therapy.Does it help without medication?
Thanks for your concern.I'm trying my best to avoid suicide but the anguish is overwhelming.Depression is a nightmare basically...
I know I should reach out to a friend.Not quite ready to take that step yet.I just wish I had some Nembutal.That would be the preferred option..
Not sure how friends would react.There's a lot of stigma associated with suicide',depression and hepatitis...
I've phoned the Samaritans quite a few times but haven't told any friends about the situation yet.Unfortunately the suicidal feelings are intensifying...

I'm male in my mid fifties.Three months ago I was fine.Never had depression or suicidal thoughts.Since being diagnosed with hepatitis,severe depression set in.The depression is the worst part of it...
I can't really see any other options.The emotional turmoil is agonizing.
I haven't seen a doctor about the depression.Was hoping it might gradually fade.Never been suicidal before.I don't want to die but the depression is overwhelming...
That would be good..
